gaps.valueSet: Rule 4: Powassan Virus Disease (Tests for Powassan Virus Antigen)
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the test-name value set not implemented with no codes, so entirely inoperable Rule 4 is omitted with source numbering preserved

gaps.valueSet: Rules 5 and 7: numeric laboratory result greater than zero
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory result comparison; the > 0 alternatives are omitted while coded positive, Powassan-organism, and abnormal-interpretation alternatives remain operational

gaps.valueSet: Rule 6: paired Powassan antibody titer rise or seroconversion
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks this rule not operational; SEM_V1 cannot compare paired specimens, onset/collection intervals, four-fold changes, or negative-to-positive conversion, so Rule 6 is omitted
the authoritative snapshot marks these reporter types not implemented in RCKMS; SEM_V1 does not carry reporter-source or death-certificate cause/contributing-condition evidence
